To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
PLAEPO / Algae composite is successfully prepared by solvent casting and melt blending.
the addition of algae filler into plasticized PLA improves the flexibility and thermal stability of the composite.
the PLAEPO/ ALG-5 nanocomposite has the potential to be used for food packaging as it shows good flexibility and thermal stability.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation and characterization of PLA/algae composite.
the preparation, characterization and optimization of PLA/algae composite to be applied as a biodegradable material in packaging industry.
the development of PLA/algae biodegradable composite and its characterization to be used in packaging industry.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the addition of algae filler into PLA matrix is proven to be successful in enhancing its mechanical and thermal properties.
PLAEPO composite is a potential candidate as a substitute for conventional plastic packaging.
the addition of algae filler in PLA/EPO composite has improved the flexibility of PLA/EPO and the addition of 5 wt% algae filler in PLA has increased the degradation rate.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
solvent casting method is the best preparation method for PLAEPO/ algae composite as it has the highest elongation at break and lowest Young’s Modulus compared to melt blending.
PLAEPO is able to increase the flexibility and decrease the degradation rate of PLA.
the addition of algae into PLA and the plasticizing of PLA with EPO is a good way to overcome the limitations and improve the properties of PLA.
The main takeaway from our work is that
PLAEPO can be used to improve the properties of PLA and the properties of PLAEPA can be enhanced by the addition of algae.
PLAEPO can be used in the packaging industry as a substitute to conventional plastic.
the PLAEPO/ ALG-5 composite prepared by solvent casting is more flexible, has better thermal and mechanical properties compared to the PLAEPO composite prepared by melt mixing.
